title: 兼容备用音60

source.prompt: TrackType: SFX. TrackType: Sound Effect, VocalType: Instrumental. Original isolated retro fantasy tactical game sound effect, crisp and restrained, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange, no copied recording. No music, no melody, no speech, no singing, no choir, no background ambience. A single neutral retro synthetic compatibility sound lasting about 0.91 seconds: a compact filtered-noise and rounded pulse gesture, dry onset, distinct but restrained short decay. Do not imply a particular weapon, character or gameplay result. No repeating sequence. Single isolated one-shot, immediate attack and natural decay within 0.91 seconds. Then silence. No second event, no repeated sequence, no music or voice.
source.negative_prompt: music, melody, rhythm loop, vocals, speech, singing, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, clipping, long reverb, background noise, cinematic trailer

editing.method: first meaningful onset, first transient, natural-decay search, bounded envelope tail

mastering.method: constant active-RMS gain with category peak ceiling

transient_shaping.method: smooth tanh soft knee only above 40 percent of source peak
transient_shaping.reason: excessive transient crest made useful event energy too quiet under original peak budget

mastering.active_rms_comparison_method: 220-sample (approximately 5ms) stereo RMS windows; active=max(0.03*max_window_rms,-55dBFS), matching source baseline
mastering.basis: Preserve original relative levels: UI not louder in active RMS; ordinary impacts at most +2dB and magic +1dB; sustained textures capped at -23dBFS active RMS.

auditory_review_note: Waveform-conditioned local audio model review completed; no human-listening claim. See audio_content_review and the linked receipt.

audio_content_review.conclusion: 候选未形成稳定提升，保留当前短反馈；仅作兼容备用。
